request.input:
An interviewer is asking the owner about their life, one question at a time.

Topic: Projects: Atlas Migration
Interviewer: I have Atlas in testing since October 2026: is that still the case?
Owner: We went live in December, a few weeks late. Now I'm cleaning up the old cluster.

questions.name: answer
questions.instructions: How does the owner's reply relate to the interviewer's question?

choices.description: it gives the information that was asked for
it gives only part of it, or stays vague
the owner does not know, has nothing to add, or it does not apply
the owner would rather not say: it is private, confidential or they keep it to themselves
it is off-topic or cannot be understood
instead of answering, the owner asks the interviewer something back or asks for more context

questions.name: new_thread
questions.instructions: Does the owner's reply bring up something specific that was not asked about (a person, a project, an event, a change or a feeling) that a friend would naturally ask about next?
